info.background_text:
An enigmatic beauty notorious for her alleged involvement of an Ark's downfall.
Though she may be a captivating beauty, those who lay eyes on her must not be wooed by her wiles. After all, this woman—Fei—is one of the universe's most dangerous, boasting the highest bounty in the history of the cosmos. Her whereabouts are elusive, but if you take on an assignment to eliminate the Chaos Order, you may cross paths with her. Her goal is the total annihilation of the Chaos Order.
